verdict.rationale: Treasury-style money-management products could plausibly offer automation rules such as sweeps or scheduled transfers, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no way to version, review, or roll back automations. The transaction ledger, webhook events, and the CLI and MCP probes are adjacent features, not versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
